description: This file defines the SupervisorEvaluationSearchFilterParams class, which extends a base FilterParams class. It is used to encapsulate filtering parameters for supervisor evaluations within the OrangeHRM performance module, specifically including a review ID and a self-evaluation indicator.

classes.name: SupervisorEvaluationSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) class for holding search filter parameters related to supervisor evaluations, including review ID and self-evaluation status.

methods.name: getReviewId
methods.description: Returns the review ID associated with the filter parameters.

methods.name: setReviewId
methods.description: Sets the review ID for the filter parameters.
